title: Assam Buranji (1906)
author: Kasinath Tamuli Phukan & Radhanath Barbarua
description: Foundational nineteenth-century chronicle composed by Kasinath Tamuli Phukan under royal commission of Swargadeo Purandar Singha and revised by Radhanath Barbarua, detailing Tai Ahom origins from Lengdon and Khunlung-Khunlai to the British annexation.

sentences.text_roman: phaa tai khyaa tii mroeng chau tsaw
sentences.assamese_script: ফা টাই খ্যা তী ম্ৰোং চৌ চউ
sentences.free_translation_en: The heavenly deities Lengdon sent Khunlung and Khunlai down to rule the earthly realm.
sentences.free_translation_as: স্বৰ্গৰ দেৱতা লেংদনে পৃথিৱী শাসন কৰিবলৈ খুনলুং আৰু খুনলাইক মৰ্ত্যলৈ নমাই দিলে।
sentences.speaker: Kasinath Tamuli Phukan (Royal Chronicler)
sentences.notes: Opening cosmogony of Kasinath Tamuli Phukan's Buranji.

sentences.text_roman: chau phaa tai khaw tii kaang mroeng
sentences.assamese_script: চৌ ফা টাই খৌ তী কাং ম্ৰোং
sentences.free_translation_en: Chao Lung Sukaphaa crossed the Patkai mountain ranges in 1228 to establish the kingdom.
sentences.free_translation_as: চৌলুং চুকাফাই ১২২৮ খ্ৰীষ্টাব্দত পাটকাই পৰ্বত পাৰ হৈ আহি ৰাজ্য স্থাপন কৰিলে।
sentences.speaker: Kasinath Tamuli Phukan

sentences.text_roman: tai phaw tii nam mii khaw
sentences.assamese_script: টাই ফৌ তী নাম মী খৌ
sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai pioneers cultivated wet-rice paddies along the Dikhou and Dihing rivers.
sentences.free_translation_as: টাই লোকসকলে দিখৌ আৰু দিহিং নদীৰ উপত্যকাত শালি খেতি কৰি সমৃদ্ধিশালী হ’ল।
sentences.speaker: Kasinath Tamuli Phukan

sentences.free_translation_en: The Borgohain and Buragohain nobles administered the realm with established tribal statutes.
sentences.free_translation_as: বৰগোঁহাই আৰু বুঢ়াগোঁহাই ডাঙৰীয়াসকলে নিয়ম-নীতিৰে ৰাজ্য পৰিচালনা কৰিলে।
sentences.speaker: Kasinath Tamuli Phukan

sentences.free_translation_en: They engineered massive earthen ramparts and causeways across the lowlands.
sentences.free_translation_as: তেওঁলোকে সমগ্ৰ উপত্যকাত বিশাল মাটিৰ গড় আৰু সুচল আলি নিৰ্মাণ কৰিলে।
sentences.speaker: Kasinath Tamuli Phukan

sentences.free_translation_en: Kasinath Tamuli Phukan's chronicle remains the primary standard for medieval Assamese historiography.
